sql: SELECT SUM(cpm_realized) / 1000 AS ad_revenue, COUNT(*) AS impressions, SUM(revenue_amount) AS rounded_rev FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery WHERE delivery_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND delivery_date < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1001

SELECT t.territory_id, t.name, t.territory_group, w.availability_status, w.active_flag, w.blackout_flag, (w.window_open_date <= CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) AND (w.window_close_date IS NULL OR w.window_close_date >= CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE))) AS in_dates, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT w.title_id) AS titles FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory AS t LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window AS w ON w.territory_id = t.territory_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Brazil%' OR t.iso_alpha_2_code = 'BR' GROUP BY ALL LIMIT 1001

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.title_id) AS titles, COUNT(*) AS windows, COUNT(DISTINCT t.title_id) AS matched_titles, SUM(CASE WHEN t.content_status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_status FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window AS w LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.title AS t ON t.title_id = w.title_id WHERE w.territory_id = 5 AND w.active_flag AND NOT w.blackout_flag AND w.availability_status = 'Active' LIMIT 1001

SELECT t.territory_group, COUNT(DISTINCT t.territory_id) AS countries, COUNT(s.subscriber_id) AS subs FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory AS t LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber AS s ON s.territory_id = t.territory_id GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 1001

WITH `genre_watch_hours` AS (
  SELECT
    `genre`.`genre_id`,
    `genre`.`name` AS `genre_name`,
    try_divide(SUM(`playback_session`.`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `watch_hours`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
  INNER JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` AS `subscriber`
    ON `playback_session`.`subscriber_id` = `subscriber`.`subscriber_id`
  INNER JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode` AS `content_episode`
    ON `playback_session`.`content_episode_id` = `content_episode`.`content_episode_id`
  INNER JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` AS `title`
    ON `content_episode`.`title_id` = `title`.`title_id`
  INNER JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`series` AS `series`
    ON `title`.`series_id` = `series`.`series_id`
  INNER JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`genre` AS `genre`
    ON `series`.`genre_id` = `genre`.`genre_id`
  WHERE `subscriber`.`service_tier` = 'Free'
    AND `genre`.`name` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `genre`.`genre_id`, `genre`.`name`
),
`ranked_genres` AS (
  SELECT
    `genre_id`,
    `genre_name`,
    `watch_hours`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `watch_hours` DESC) AS `genre_rank`
  FROM `genre_watch_hours`
)
SELECT
  `genre_name`,
  `watch_hours`
FROM `ranked_genres`
WHERE `genre_rank` <= 3
ORDER BY `watch_hours` DESC, `genre_name` ASC;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(`ad_breaks_served_count`), 0) AS `total_ad_breaks`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session`
WHERE `session_start_timestamp` >= DATE'2026-10-01'
  AND `session_start_timestamp` < DATE'2026-11-01'

WITH `platform_cancellations` AS ( SELECT `churn_event`.`ott_platform_id` AS `platform`, COUNT(*) AS `cancellations` FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`churn_event` AS `churn_event` WHERE `churn_event`.`ott_platform_id` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `churn_event`.`ott_platform_id` ), `ranked_platforms` AS ( SELECT `platform`, `cancellations`, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `cancellations` DESC) AS `platform_rank` FROM `platform_cancellations` ) SELECT `platform`, `cancellations` FROM `ranked_platforms` WHERE `platform_rank` <= 3 ORDER BY `cancellations` DESC, `platform` ASC

WITH `title_october_views` AS (
  SELECT
    `t`.`title_id`,
    COUNT(`p`.`playback_session_id`) AS `october_sessions`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` AS `t`
  LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode` AS `e`
    ON `e`.`title_id` = `t`.`title_id`
  LEFT JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `p`
    ON `p`.`content_episode_id` = `e`.`content_episode_id`
   AND `p`.`session_start_timestamp` >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
   AND `p`.`session_start_timestamp` < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY `t`.`title_id`
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS `titles_with_zero_views`
FROM `title_october_views`
WHERE `october_sessions` = 0

SELECT s.series_id, s.title, COUNT(*) AS sessions, ROUND(SUM(p.total_watch_duration_seconds) / 3600.0, 0) AS watch_hours FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session AS p JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.content_episode AS e ON e.content_episode_id = p.content_episode_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.series AS s ON s.series_id = e.content_series_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY watch_hours DESC LIMIT 10

WITH top AS (SELECT e.content_series_id AS series_id, SUM(p.total_watch_duration_seconds) / 3600.0 AS wh FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session AS p JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.content_episode AS e ON e.content_episode_id = p.content_episode_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY wh DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT s.title AS series, a.advertiser_id, a.trade_name, a.industry_category, COUNT(*) AS campaigns, SUM(c.total_budget_amount) AS planned_budget FROM top AS t JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.series AS s ON s.series_id = t.series_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.campaign AS c ON c.series_id = t.series_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.advertiser AS a ON a.advertiser_id = c.advertiser_id GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, t.wh ORDER BY t.wh DESC, campaigns DESC LIMIT 1001

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.subscriber_id) AS subs FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_billing.invoice AS i JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session AS p ON p.subscriber_id = i.subscriber_id WHERE i.invoice_status = 'Overdue' AND p.session_start_timestamp >= CAST('2026-10-11' AS DATE) AND p.session_start_timestamp < CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) LIMIT 1001

SELECT e.title_id, t.name, t.content_type, COUNT(*) AS sessions, SUM(p.total_watch_duration_seconds) / 3600.0 AS watch_hours FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session AS p JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.content_episode AS e ON p.content_episode_id = e.content_episode_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.title AS t ON t.title_id = e.title_id GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY watch_hours DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT territory_id) AS countries, COUNT(*) AS windows, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN active_flag AND NOT blackout_flag THEN territory_id END) AS active_not_blackout, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN availability_status = 'Active' THEN territory_id END) AS status_active, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN active_flag THEN territory_id END) AS active_flag_countries FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window WHERE title_id = 1 LIMIT 1001
SELECT availability_status, active_flag, blackout_flag, COUNT(*) AS n FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window WHERE title_id = 1 GROUP BY ALL LIMIT 1001

WITH monthly_mrr AS (
  SELECT
    m.month_start,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN sp.contract_term_months = 12 THEN TRY_DIVIDE(s.base_rate_amount, 12)
        ELSE s.base_rate_amount
      END
    ) AS mrr
  FROM (
    SELECT EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(TO_DATE('2026-04-01'), TO_DATE('2026-10-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AS month_start
  ) AS m
  JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription AS s
    ON s.activation_date <= LAST_DAY(m.month_start)
   AND (s.termination_date IS NULL OR s.termination_date > LAST_DAY(m.month_start))
  JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription_plan AS sp
    ON s.subscription_plan_id = sp.subscription_plan_id
  WHERE sp.plan_type = 'Paid'
    AND m.month_start IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY m.month_start
), growth AS (
  SELECT
    monthly_mrr.month_start,
    monthly_mrr.mrr,
    LAG(monthly_mrr.mrr) OVER (ORDER BY monthly_mrr.month_start) AS previous_month_mrr
  FROM monthly_mrr
)
SELECT
  growth.month_start,
  growth.mrr,
  growth.previous_month_mrr,
  100 * TRY_DIVIDE(growth.mrr - growth.previous_month_mrr, growth.previous_month_mrr) AS mom_mrr_growth_percent
FROM growth
WHERE growth.month_start >= TO_DATE('2026-05-01')
  AND growth.month_start <= TO_DATE('2026-10-01')
ORDER BY growth.month_start

WITH `signup_cohort` AS (
  SELECT
    `subscription`.`subscriber_id`,
    MIN(`subscription`.`activation_date`) AS `signup_date`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
  WHERE `subscription`.`activation_date` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `subscription`.`subscriber_id`
),
`q1_signup_cohort` AS (
  SELECT `subscriber_id`
  FROM `signup_cohort`
  WHERE `signup_date` >= DATE'2026-01-01'
    AND `signup_date` < DATE'2026-04-01'
),
`current_paid_subscribers` AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
    ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
  WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
    AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN `current_paid_subscribers`.`subscriber_id` IS NOT NULL THEN `q1_signup_cohort`.`subscriber_id` END) AS `paid_today_subscribers`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT `q1_signup_cohort`.`subscriber_id`) AS `q1_joiners`,
  try_divide(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN `current_paid_subscribers`.`subscriber_id` IS NOT NULL THEN `q1_signup_cohort`.`subscriber_id` END),COUNT(DISTINCT `q1_signup_cohort`.`subscriber_id`)) AS `pct_on_paid_plan_today`
FROM `q1_signup_cohort`
LEFT JOIN `current_paid_subscribers`
  ON `q1_signup_cohort`.`subscriber_id` = `current_paid_subscribers`.`subscriber_id`

WITH `subscription_history` AS (
  SELECT
    `s`.`subscriber_id`,
    `s`.`activation_date`,
    `sp`.`plan_type`,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY `s`.`subscriber_id`
      ORDER BY `s`.`activation_date`, `s`.`subscription_id`
    ) AS `subscription_order`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `s`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `sp`
    ON `s`.`subscription_plan_id` = `sp`.`subscription_plan_id`
  WHERE `s`.`activation_date` IS NOT NULL
    AND `sp`.`plan_type` IS NOT NULL
), `free_starters` AS (
  SELECT
    `subscriber_id`,
    `activation_date` AS `first_free_activation_date`
  FROM `subscription_history`
  WHERE `subscription_order` = 1
    AND `plan_type` = 'Free'
), `first_paid_upgrade` AS (
  SELECT
    `s`.`subscriber_id`,
    MIN(`s`.`activation_date`) AS `first_paid_activation_date`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `s`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `sp`
    ON `s`.`subscription_plan_id` = `sp`.`subscription_plan_id`
  WHERE `s`.`activation_date` IS NOT NULL
    AND `sp`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
    AND `sp`.`plan_type` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `s`.`subscriber_id`
), `upgrade_times` AS (
  SELECT
    `f`.`subscriber_id`,
    DATEDIFF(`p`.`first_paid_activation_date`, `f`.`first_free_activation_date`) AS `days_on_free_before_upgrade`
  FROM `free_starters` AS `f`
  JOIN `first_paid_upgrade` AS `p`
    ON `f`.`subscriber_id` = `p`.`subscriber_id`
  WHERE `p`.`first_paid_activation_date` > `f`.`first_free_activation_date`
)
SELECT
  percentile_approx(`days_on_free_before_upgrade`, 0.5) AS `median_days_on_free_before_upgrade`,
  COUNT(*) AS `upgraded_subscribers`
FROM `upgrade_times`;

WITH `plan_payment_stats` AS (
  SELECT
    `sp`.`subscription_plan_id`,
    `sp`.`plan_name`,
    try_divide(SUM(CASE WHEN `p`.`payment_status` = 'Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0,COUNT(*)) AS `payment_failure_rate`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`payment` AS `p`
  INNER JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`invoice` AS `i`
    ON `p`.`invoice_id` = `i`.`invoice_id`
  INNER JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `sp`
    ON `i`.`subscription_plan_id` = `sp`.`subscription_plan_id`
  WHERE `i`.`subscription_plan_id` IS NOT NULL
    AND `sp`.`plan_name` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `sp`.`subscription_plan_id`, `sp`.`plan_name`
),
`plan_overdue` AS (
  SELECT
    `sp`.`subscription_plan_id`,
    SUM(`i`.`total_amount_due`) AS `overdue_invoice_amount`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`invoice` AS `i`
  INNER JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `sp`
    ON `i`.`subscription_plan_id` = `sp`.`subscription_plan_id`
  WHERE `i`.`subscription_plan_id` IS NOT NULL
    AND `sp`.`plan_name` IS NOT NULL
    AND `i`.`invoice_status` = 'Overdue'
  GROUP BY `sp`.`subscription_plan_id`
),
`ranked` AS (
  SELECT
    `pps`.`plan_name`,
    `pps`.`payment_failure_rate`,
    COALESCE(`po`.`overdue_invoice_amount`, 0) AS `overdue_invoice_amount`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `pps`.`payment_failure_rate` DESC, COALESCE(`po`.`overdue_invoice_amount`, 0) DESC) AS `plan_rank`
  FROM `plan_payment_stats` AS `pps`
  LEFT JOIN `plan_overdue` AS `po`
    ON `pps`.`subscription_plan_id` = `po`.`subscription_plan_id`
)
SELECT
  `plan_name`,
  `payment_failure_rate`,
  `overdue_invoice_amount`
FROM `ranked`
WHERE `plan_rank` <= 1
ORDER BY `payment_failure_rate` DESC, `overdue_invoice_amount` DESC

WITH monthly_country_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    territory.name AS country,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', invoice.invoice_date) AS month,
    SUM(invoice.subtotal_amount - invoice.discount_amount) AS monthly_revenue
  FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_billing.invoice AS invoice
  JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber AS subscriber
    ON invoice.subscriber_id = subscriber.subscriber_id
  JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory AS territory
    ON subscriber.territory_id = territory.territory_id
  WHERE invoice.invoice_date IS NOT NULL
    AND territory.name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY territory.name, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', invoice.invoice_date)
),
monthly_country_paying_subscribers AS (
  SELECT
    territory.name AS country,
    month_start.month AS month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT subscription.subscriber_id) AS paying_subscribers
  FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription AS subscription
  JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription_plan AS subscription_plan
    ON subscription.subscription_plan_id = subscription_plan.subscription_plan_id
  JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber AS subscriber
    ON subscription.subscriber_id = subscriber.subscriber_id
  JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory AS territory
    ON subscriber.territory_id = territory.territory_id
  JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', invoice.invoice_date) AS month
    FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_billing.invoice AS invoice
    WHERE invoice.invoice_date IS NOT NULL
  ) AS month_start
    ON subscription.activation_date <= LAST_DAY(month_start.month)
   AND (subscription.termination_date IS NULL OR subscription.termination_date > LAST_DAY(month_start.month))
  WHERE subscription.subscription_status = 'Active'
    AND subscription_plan.plan_type = 'Paid'
    AND territory.name IS NOT NULL
    AND month_start.month IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY territory.name, month_start.month
),
country_monthly_ratio AS (
  SELECT
    monthly_country_revenue.country,
    monthly_country_revenue.month,
    TRY_DIVIDE(monthly_country_revenue.monthly_revenue, monthly_country_paying_subscribers.paying_subscribers) AS revenue_per_paying_subscriber
  FROM monthly_country_revenue
  JOIN monthly_country_paying_subscribers
    ON monthly_country_revenue.country = monthly_country_paying_subscribers.country
   AND monthly_country_revenue.month = monthly_country_paying_subscribers.month
  WHERE monthly_country_paying_subscribers.paying_subscribers > 0
),
country_avg AS (
  SELECT
    country,
    AVG(revenue_per_paying_subscriber) AS avg_monthly_revenue_per_paying_subscriber
  FROM country_monthly_ratio
  GROUP BY country
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    country,
    avg_monthly_revenue_per_paying_subscriber,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_monthly_revenue_per_paying_subscriber DESC) AS rnk
  FROM country_avg
)
SELECT
  country,
  avg_monthly_revenue_per_paying_subscriber
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY avg_monthly_revenue_per_paying_subscriber DESC, country ASC;

WITH `title_watch_hours` AS (
  SELECT
    `territory`.`territory_group` AS `region`,
    `title`.`name` AS `title_name`,
    try_divide(SUM(`playback_session`.`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `watch_hours`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode` AS `content_episode`
    ON `playback_session`.`content_episode_id` = `content_episode`.`content_episode_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` AS `title`
    ON `content_episode`.`title_id` = `title`.`title_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` AS `subscriber`
    ON `playback_session`.`subscriber_id` = `subscriber`.`subscriber_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` AS `territory`
    ON `subscriber`.`territory_id` = `territory`.`territory_id`
  WHERE `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp` >= TIMESTAMP'2026-07-01 00:00:00'
    AND `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp` < TIMESTAMP'2026-10-01 00:00:00'
    AND `territory`.`territory_group` IS NOT NULL
    AND `title`.`name` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    `territory`.`territory_group`,
    `title`.`name`
), `ranked_titles` AS (
  SELECT
    `region`,
    `title_name`,
    `watch_hours`,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY `region` ORDER BY `watch_hours` DESC) AS `region_rank`
  FROM `title_watch_hours`
)
SELECT
  `region`,
  `title_name`,
  `watch_hours`
FROM `ranked_titles`
WHERE `region_rank` = 1
ORDER BY `region` ASC, `title_name` ASC;

WITH october_viewer_franchises AS (
  SELECT
    `playback_session`.`subscriber_id`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT `series`.`franchise_name`) AS `franchise_count`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
  INNER JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode` AS `content_episode`
    ON `playback_session`.`content_episode_id` = `content_episode`.`content_episode_id`
  INNER JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` AS `title`
    ON `content_episode`.`title_id` = `title`.`title_id`
  INNER JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`series` AS `series`
    ON `title`.`series_id` = `series`.`series_id`
  WHERE `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp` >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
    AND `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp` < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01 00:00:00'
    AND `playback_session`.`subscriber_id` IS NOT NULL
    AND `series`.`franchise_name` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `playback_session`.`subscriber_id`
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN `franchise_count` > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `viewers_more_than_one_franchise`,
  COUNT(*) AS `total_october_viewers`,
  try_divide(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN `franchise_count` > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),COUNT(*)) AS `share_percent`
FROM october_viewer_franchises;

WITH `viewer_watch` AS (
  SELECT
    `subscriber_id`,
    try_divide(SUM(`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `watch_hours`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session`
  WHERE `session_start_timestamp` >= TIMESTAMP('2026-10-01 00:00:00')
    AND `session_start_timestamp` < TIMESTAMP('2026-11-01 00:00:00')
    AND `subscriber_id` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `subscriber_id`
),
`ranked` AS (
  SELECT
    `subscriber_id`,
    `watch_hours`,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY `watch_hours` DESC, `subscriber_id`) AS `viewer_rank`,
    SUM(`watch_hours`) OVER (ORDER BY `watch_hours` DESC, `subscriber_id` ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `cumulative_watch_hours`,
    SUM(`watch_hours`) OVER () AS `total_watch_hours`,
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS `total_viewers`
  FROM `viewer_watch`
),
`threshold` AS (
  SELECT
    `total_viewers`,
    `total_watch_hours`,
    `viewer_rank` AS `viewers_needed_for_50pct_hours`,
    try_divide(100.0 * `viewer_rank`,`total_viewers`) AS `viewer_percentage_for_50pct_hours`
  FROM `ranked`
  WHERE `cumulative_watch_hours` >= 0.5 * `total_watch_hours`
  ORDER BY `viewer_rank`
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  `total_viewers`,
  `total_watch_hours`,
  `viewers_needed_for_50pct_hours`,
  `viewer_percentage_for_50pct_hours`
FROM `threshold`

SELECT statement_status, currency_code, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(net_royalty_amount) AS net, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT paid_timestamp IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_ts, SUM(CASE WHEN statement_due_date < CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pastdue, COUNT(DISTINCT holder_id) AS h FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.royalty_statement GROUP BY 1, 2 LIMIT 1001

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN s.holder_id = a.primary_license_holder_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.royalty_statement AS s JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.license_agreement AS a ON a.license_agreement_id = s.license_agreement_id LIMIT 1001

SELECT h.holder_id, h.rights_holder_name, SUM(CASE WHEN s.statement_status = 'Overdue' THEN s.net_royalty_amount ELSE 0 END) AS overdue, SUM(s.net_royalty_amount) AS billed, SUM(CASE WHEN s.statement_status = 'Overdue' THEN s.net_royalty_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(s.net_royalty_amount) AS share FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.royalty_statement AS s JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.holder AS h ON h.holder_id = s.holder_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 5

WITH d AS (SELECT campaign_id, COUNT(*) AS delivered FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery GROUP BY campaign_id) SELECT c.campaign_type, COUNT(*) AS campaigns, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.delivered, 0) >= 0.95 * c.target_impressions THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hit, ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.delivered, 0) >= 0.95 * c.target_impressions THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS pct, SUM(CASE WHEN d.delivered IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_delivery, MIN(c.end_date) AS mn, MAX(c.end_date) AS mx FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.campaign AS c LEFT JOIN d ON d.campaign_id = c.campaign_id WHERE c.campaign_status = 'Completed' GROUP BY c.campaign_type ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1001

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', signed_date) AS q, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(total_license_fee) AS fee, MIN(signed_date) AS mn, MAX(signed_date) AS mx, COUNT(DISTINCT currency_code) AS c FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.license_agreement WHERE signed_date >= CAST('2024-11-10' AS DATE) AND signed_date < CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1001

SELECT agreement_type, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(signed_date) AS with_signed, ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(DAY, signed_date, effective_date)), 1) AS avg_days, MIN(DATEDIFF(DAY, signed_date, effective_date)) AS min_days, MAX(DATEDIFF(DAY, signed_date, effective_date)) AS max_days, SUM(CASE WHEN effective_date < signed_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS eff_before_signed FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.license_agreement GROUP BY agreement_type ORDER BY agreement_type LIMIT 1001

SELECT COUNT(*) AS churned_subscriptions
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`churn_event` AS `churn_event`
WHERE `churn_event`.`churn_timestamp` >= TIMESTAMP('2026-10-01')
  AND `churn_event`.`churn_timestamp` < TIMESTAMP('2026-11-01')

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT `s`.`base_rate_amount`) AS `distinct_monthly_prices`,
  MIN(`s`.`base_rate_amount`) AS `min_monthly_price`,
  MAX(`s`.`base_rate_amount`) AS `max_monthly_price`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `s`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` AS `sub`
  ON `s`.`subscriber_id` = `sub`.`subscriber_id`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` AS `t`
  ON `sub`.`territory_id` = `t`.`territory_id`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `sp`
  ON `s`.`subscription_plan_id` = `sp`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `s`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `s`.`subscription_type` = 'Monthly'
  AND `sp`.`service_tier` = 'Fan'
  AND `sp`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `t`.`name` = 'Brazil'
  AND `s`.`base_rate_amount` IS NOT NULL

SELECT ROUND(SUM(`payment`.`amount`), 2) AS `total_payments_received`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`payment` AS `payment`
WHERE `payment`.`payment_status` = 'Succeeded'
  AND `payment`.`payment_date` >= DATE'2026-10-01'
  AND `payment`.`payment_date` < DATE'2026-11-01'

SELECT try_divide(SUM(`playback_session`.`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `watch_hours`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode` AS `content_episode`
  ON `playback_session`.`content_episode_id` = `content_episode`.`content_episode_id`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title` AS `title`
  ON `content_episode`.`title_id` = `title`.`title_id`
WHERE `title`.`name` = 'Paper Tempest: The Film'

WITH `na_active_accounts` AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS `active_accounts_na`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` AS `subscriber`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` AS `territory`
    ON `subscriber`.`territory_id` = `territory`.`territory_id`
  WHERE `subscriber`.`account_status` = 'Active'
    AND `territory`.`territory_group` = 'NA'
),
`na_countries` AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT `territory`.`name` AS `country_name`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` AS `territory`
  WHERE `territory`.`territory_group` = 'NA'
    AND `territory`.`name` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  `na_active_accounts`.`active_accounts_na`,
  CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(`na_countries`.`country_name`))) AS `north_america_countries`
FROM `na_active_accounts`
CROSS JOIN `na_countries`
GROUP BY `na_active_accounts`.`active_accounts_na`

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN agreement_status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_active, SUM(CASE WHEN effective_date <= CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) AND expiry_date >= CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_force_dates, SUM(CASE WHEN effective_date <= CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) AND expiry_date > CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_force_strict, SUM(CASE WHEN agreement_status = 'Active' AND effective_date <= CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) AND expiry_date >= CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS both, SUM(CASE WHEN effective_date > CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_started, SUM(CASE WHEN expiry_date IS NULL OR effective_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nulls, SUM(CASE WHEN expiry_date = CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expiring_today FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.license_agreement LIMIT 1001

SELECT is_recoupable, mg_type, mg_status, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(mg_amount) AS mg, SUM(recouped_to_date_amount) AS rec, SUM(outstanding_balance_amount) AS outst, ROUND(100 * SUM(recouped_to_date_amount) / SUM(mg_amount), 2) AS pct FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.minimum_guarantee GROUP BY ROLLUP (is_recoupable, mg_type, mg_status) ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 LIMIT 1001

WITH `first_signup` AS (
  SELECT
    `subscription`.`subscriber_id`,
    MIN(`subscription`.`activation_date`) AS `signup_date`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
  WHERE `subscription`.`activation_date` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `subscription`.`subscriber_id`
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS `signups`
FROM `first_signup`
WHERE `signup_date` BETWEEN DATE'2024-01-01' AND DATE'2024-01-07'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS `churn`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`churn_event`
WHERE `churn_timestamp` >= TIMESTAMP('2026-11-01 00:00:00')
  AND `churn_timestamp` < TIMESTAMP('2026-12-01 00:00:00')

SELECT advertiser_id, legal_name, trade_name, industry_category FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.advertiser WHERE legal_name ILIKE '%larkspur%' OR trade_name ILIKE '%larkspur%' LIMIT 1001

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS i JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.campaign AS c ON c.campaign_id = i.campaign_id WHERE c.advertiser_id = 1 LIMIT 1001

SELECT s.franchise_name, COUNT(*) AS impressions, COUNT(DISTINCT i.campaign_id) AS campaigns FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS i JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.campaign AS c ON c.campaign_id = i.campaign_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.content_episode AS e ON e.content_episode_id = i.content_episode_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.series AS s ON s.series_id = e.content_series_id WHERE c.advertiser_id = 1 GROUP BY s.franchise_name ORDER BY impressions DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT statement_status, paid_timestamp IS NULL AS unpaid, statement_due_date < CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) AS past_due, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(net_royalty_amount) AS net, SUM(gross_royalty_amount) AS gross, MIN(statement_due_date) AS mind, MAX(statement_due_date) AS maxd FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.royalty_statement GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 LIMIT 1001

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(`invoice`.`amount_paid`), 0) AS `total_revenue_collected`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`invoice` AS `invoice`
WHERE `invoice`.`invoice_date` >= DATE'2026-10-01'
  AND `invoice`.`invoice_date` < DATE'2026-11-01'

WITH rev AS (SELECT SUM(cpm_realized) / 1000 AS ad_rev, COUNT(*) AS imps, COUNT(DISTINCT subscriber_id) AS served_subs FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery WHERE delivery_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND delivery_date < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE)), fs AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.subscriber_id) AS free_subs FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription AS s JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription_plan AS p ON s.subscription_plan_id = p.subscription_plan_id WHERE p.plan_type = 'Free' AND s.activation_date <= CAST('2026-10-31' AS DATE) AND (s.termination_date IS NULL OR s.termination_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE))) SELECT rev.*, fs.free_subs, rev.ad_rev / fs.free_subs AS per_free_sub, rev.ad_rev / rev.served_subs AS per_served FROM rev CROSS JOIN fs LIMIT 1001

SELECT (SELECT SUM(total_license_fee) FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.license_agreement WHERE expiry_date >= CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) AND expiry_date <= CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAYS) AS fee, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.license_agreement WHERE expiry_date >= CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) AND expiry_date <= CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAYS) AS n, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT subscriber_id) FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription WHERE subscription_status = 'Active' AND subscription_type <> 'Free') AS paying LIMIT 1001

WITH s AS (SELECT p.total_watch_duration_seconds / 3600.0 AS hrs, e.title_id, sub.territory_id FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session AS p JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber AS sub ON sub.subscriber_id = p.subscriber_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.content_episode AS e ON e.content_episode_id = p.content_episode_id WHERE p.session_start_timestamp >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND p.session_start_timestamp < CAST('2026-11-01' AS TIMESTAMP)), act AS (SELECT DISTINCT title_id, territory_id FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window WHERE active_flag = TRUE) SELECT SUM(hrs) AS total_hrs, SUM(CASE WHEN a.title_id IS NULL THEN hrs ELSE 0 END) AS no_active_hrs, SUM(CASE WHEN a.title_id IS NULL THEN hrs ELSE 0 END) / SUM(hrs) AS share, COUNT(*) AS sessions, SUM(CASE WHEN a.title_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sess_no_active FROM s LEFT JOIN act AS a ON a.title_id = s.title_id AND a.territory_id = s.territory_id LIMIT 1001

WITH ep AS (SELECT e.content_episode_id, s.franchise_name FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.content_episode AS e LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.title AS t ON t.title_id = e.title_id LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.series AS s ON s.series_id = COALESCE(e.content_series_id, t.series_id)), w AS (SELECT ep.franchise_name, SUM(p.total_watch_duration_seconds) / 3600.0 AS watch_hours FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session AS p JOIN ep ON ep.content_episode_id = p.content_episode_id GROUP BY 1), i AS (SELECT ep.franchise_name, SUM(d.total_impressions_served) AS impressions FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS d JOIN ep ON ep.content_episode_id = d.content_episode_id GROUP BY 1) SELECT w.franchise_name, w.watch_hours, i.impressions FROM w LEFT JOIN i USING (franchise_name) ORDER BY w.watch_hours DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT `territory`.`territory_group` AS `region`, COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `paying_subscribers`, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN `subscription`.`subscription_type` = 'Annual' THEN try_divide(`subscription`.`base_rate_amount`,12) ELSE `subscription`.`base_rate_amount` END), 2) AS `mrr`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` AS `subscriber`
  ON `subscription`.`subscriber_id` = `subscriber`.`subscriber_id`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` AS `territory`
  ON `subscriber`.`territory_id` = `territory`.`territory_id`
WHERE `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription`.`activation_date` <= DATE'2026-10-31'
  AND (`subscription`.`termination_date` IS NULL OR `subscription`.`termination_date` >= DATE'2026-10-01')
  AND `territory`.`territory_group` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `territory`.`territory_group`
ORDER BY `mrr` DESC

SELECT SPLIT(p.platform_code, '-')[1] AS region, COUNT(*) AS impressions, SUM(i.viewable_impressions) AS viewable FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS i LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session AS s ON i.playback_session_id = s.playback_session_id LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.ott_platform AS p ON s.ott_platform_id = p.ott_platform_id WHERE i.delivery_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND i.delivery_date < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1001
SELECT title_id, series_id, name, content_type, season_number FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.title WHERE name ILIKE '%Ashen Tempest%' LIMIT 1001

SELECT d.acquisition_deal_id, d.deal_title, d.partner_id, a.license_agreement_id, h.rights_holder_name FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.acquisition_deal AS d LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.license_agreement AS a ON a.acquisition_deal_id = d.acquisition_deal_id LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.holder AS h ON h.holder_id = a.primary_license_holder_id WHERE d.deal_title ILIKE '%Ashen%' OR d.deal_title ILIKE '%Tempest%' LIMIT 1001

WITH first_sub AS (SELECT subscriber_id, acquisition_channel, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subscriber_id ORDER BY activation_date, subscription_id) AS rn FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription) SELECT acquisition_channel, COUNT(*) AS signups FROM first_sub WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1001

WITH `episode_errors` AS (
  SELECT
    `content_episode`.`content_episode_id`,
    `content_episode`.`title` AS `episode_title`,
    COUNT(`playback_session`.`playback_session_id`) AS `subtitle_error_reports`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode` AS `content_episode`
    ON `playback_session`.`content_episode_id` = `content_episode`.`content_episode_id`
  WHERE `playback_session`.`exit_reason` = 'Error'
    AND `playback_session`.`subtitle_language` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    `content_episode`.`content_episode_id`,
    `content_episode`.`title`
), `ranked_episode_errors` AS (
  SELECT
    `content_episode_id`,
    `episode_title`,
    `subtitle_error_reports`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `subtitle_error_reports` DESC) AS `subtitle_error_rank`
  FROM `episode_errors`
)
SELECT
  `content_episode_id`,
  `episode_title`,
  `subtitle_error_reports`
FROM `ranked_episode_errors`
WHERE `subtitle_error_rank` = 1
ORDER BY `subtitle_error_reports` DESC, `content_episode_id` ASC

SELECT h.holder_id, h.rights_holder_name, SUM(a.total_license_fee) AS total_fee, COUNT(*) AS agreements FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.license_agreement AS a JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.holder AS h ON a.primary_license_holder_id = h.holder_id GROUP BY h.holder_id, h.rights_holder_name ORDER BY total_fee DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT h.rights_holder_name, s.holder_id, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(net_royalty_amount) AS net_owed, SUM(gross_royalty_amount) AS gross, MIN(statement_due_date) AS oldest_due, SUM(CASE WHEN a.primary_license_holder_id <> s.holder_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatch, COUNT(paid_timestamp) AS paid_ts FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.royalty_statement AS s JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.holder AS h ON h.holder_id = s.holder_id LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.license_agreement AS a ON a.license_agreement_id = s.license_agreement_id WHERE s.statement_status = 'Overdue' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY net_owed DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT holder_id, rights_holder_name FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.holder WHERE LOWER(rights_holder_name) LIKE '%tidal%' LIMIT 1001

SELECT agreement_number, agreement_status, effective_date, expiry_date FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.license_agreement WHERE primary_license_holder_id = 38 ORDER BY expiry_date LIMIT 1001

SELECT agreement_status, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(expiry_date), MAX(expiry_date), SUM(CASE WHEN expiry_date >= CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_expired FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.license_agreement GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 1001
SELECT Advertiser, MEASURE(`Impressions Delivered`) AS imps FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.ad_delivery_metrics GROUP BY Advertiser ORDER BY imps DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT a.advertiser_id, a.trade_name, a.legal_name, COUNT(*) AS imps FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS i JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.campaign AS c ON i.campaign_id = c.campaign_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.advertiser AS a ON c.advertiser_id = a.advertiser_id GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY imps DESC LIMIT 7

WITH d AS (SELECT campaign_id, COUNT(*) AS delivered FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery GROUP BY campaign_id) SELECT a.advertiser_id, a.trade_name, COUNT(*) AS campaigns, SUM(c.target_impressions) AS target, SUM(COALESCE(d.delivered, 0)) AS delivered, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(d.delivered, 0)) / SUM(c.target_impressions), 4) AS delivery_ratio FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.campaign AS c JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.advertiser AS a ON a.advertiser_id = c.advertiser_id LEFT JOIN d ON d.campaign_id = c.campaign_id GROUP BY a.advertiser_id, a.trade_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY delivery_ratio ASC LIMIT 1001
SELECT advertiser_id, legal_name, trade_name FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.advertiser WHERE legal_name ILIKE '%larkspur%' OR trade_name ILIKE '%larkspur%' LIMIT 1001

WITH d AS (SELECT campaign_id, SUM(total_impressions_served) AS delivered FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery GROUP BY campaign_id) SELECT c.campaign_type, COUNT(*) AS campaigns, SUM(c.target_impressions) AS target, COALESCE(SUM(d.delivered), 0) AS delivered, COALESCE(SUM(d.delivered), 0) / SUM(c.target_impressions) AS ratio FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.campaign AS c LEFT JOIN d ON d.campaign_id = c.campaign_id WHERE c.advertiser_id = 1 GROUP BY c.campaign_type ORDER BY c.campaign_type LIMIT 1001

SELECT a.advertiser_id, a.legal_name, a.trade_name, COUNT(o.ad_order_id) AS n, SUM(o.total_contracted_value) AS tcv, SUM(o.net_order_value) AS net FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.advertiser AS a LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.ad_order AS o ON o.advertiser_id = a.advertiser_id WHERE LOWER(a.legal_name) LIKE '%larkspur%' OR LOWER(a.trade_name) LIKE '%larkspur%' GROUP BY ALL LIMIT 1001

SELECT order_status, currency_code, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(total_contracted_value) AS tcv, MIN(total_contracted_value) AS mn, MAX(total_contracted_value) AS mx, MIN(flight_start_date) AS s, MAX(flight_end_date) AS e FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.ad_order WHERE advertiser_id = 1 GROUP BY ALL LIMIT 1001
SELECT deal_status, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT acquisition_deal_id) AS d FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.acquisition_deal GROUP BY deal_status LIMIT 1001
